programmes.d: A 1970 Hemi Charger is restored.
The 1970 Hemi Charger project is completed in the season finale.

The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.
Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

With Mark out of the shop looking at a potential new location for a Mopar car-dealership, the Graveyard Ghouls begin the drivetrain assembly's for a 1970 Lime Light Tribute Superbird and our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger.
Mark the the Graveyard Ghouls race against the clock to finish up some last-minute tasks on their various Mopar restorations before traveling north to judge Little Creek Casino's epic car show.

With our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger nearing completion, works shifts to our 1970 Tribute Superbird while Mark and Cousin Dougie build out a 340 engine and Will assists with metal work with George to help him stay on schedule.
The Phoenix Cuda: A legendary Mopar which was incinerated and from the ashes, will be reborn at Graveyard Carz.

Nick Rutter provides tips and techniques for restoring dull, faded paint using a forced-rotation dual action polisher along with a graphene 3-in-1 ceramic polish, along with severe scratch and scuff removal.
Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how super clean automotive upholstery, as well as the proper chemicals and detailing tools for deep cleaning vinyl and rubber surfaces.
Kevin and Bryan tear up a motor to see the importance of the serpentine belt.
Kevin takes us through variable cam timing in Ford's new 5.0L power plant.
Fuller and Byrd bring back the Café Racer Honda bike and show you how to open up the jets in the carburetor for better performance.
We look at the technology behind turbochargers and intercoolers as we install some upgrades on a F250 Super Duty.
Bryan takes a trip to San Antonio to teach some of our nations heroes how to weld.
We tackle an A/C cooling problem on a Toyota Tacoma and introduce you to Kevin's Hot Rod BMW.
Kevin and Bryan continue the work on Kevin's LSM3 project.
Kevin travels to Indiana to solve the mysteries of the catalytic converter.
A California collector gambles on a big payday from his Crocker/Caddy combo.
"The Century Race": Dale believes he found the bike that will help him beat a rival in an annual race of 100 year old motorcycles. But will it run?
"A Motorcycle Crime Story": The horrific tale of a double murder over money and motorcycles.
"Yes, Dale there is a 100 Year Old Harley": Dale hopes his labor of love becomes a prized possession when a six-figure Harley goes to auction.
A thousand bulging barns of choppers, bobbers, and board trackers are emptied and on display in the Quad Cities.
A vague tip leads Matt and Dale into a WWII era military warehouse and beyond.
A cross-country race to lay claim to some of the world's most sought after works specials.
"12hrs. & Running": Dale turns a surprise 60th birthday party into a challenge to his guests to start 120 of the rarest motorcycles in the world.
